title: Why the Sun and the Moon Live in the Sky
author: Conte efik (Nigeria)
desc: Autrefois, le Soleil et la Lune vivaient sur la terre. Puis l'Eau vint leur rendre visite…

p: A very long time ago, the Sun and the Moon did not live in the sky. They lived on the earth, in a nice house, like you and me.
The Sun's best friend was Water. Every day, the Sun went to visit Water. They talked, they laughed, they told stories.
But Water never came to visit the Sun.
"Why don't you ever come to my house?" asked the Sun one day.
"Your house is too small," said Water. "My family is very big. If we come, there will be no space for you."
"Then I will build a bigger house!" said the Sun.
The Sun went home and told his wife, the Moon. Together they built a very big house. It was the biggest house in the world.
Then the Sun said to Water: "Come now! My house is ready."
Water arrived at the door with all his family: the fish, the crocodiles, the frogs, the snakes, all the animals of the water.
"Can we come in?" asked Water.
"Of course! Come in!" said the Sun.
Water came in. Soon the water was up to the knees. Then up to the waist.
"Can we still come in?" asked Water.
"Yes, yes, come in," said the Sun and the Moon, politely.
More water came in. It reached the roof. The Sun and the Moon had to sit on top of the roof.
"Can we still come in?" asked Water.
The Sun and the Moon did not want to be rude. "Yes, come in," they said.
The water continued to rise. Higher and higher. The Sun and the Moon had to go up, up, up, into the sky.
And they stayed there. The house was full of Water and his family, and there was no place for them anymore.
This is why, today, the Sun and the Moon live in the sky. And when you see the sea, remember: it was once the house of the Sun.
